findings.summary: F.pad(x,(0,pw,0,ph),mode='replicate') on a 5D tensor raises NotImplementedError on torch 2.14 whenever H or W is not a multiple of 16.
findings.evidence: probe: input [1,1,6,37,41] gives 'Padding size 4 is not supported for 5D input tensor'
findings.correction: use (0,pw,0,ph,0,0); add a test with odd H/W and D in {6,9,10,13,20}
findings.status: FIXED_IN_SNAPSHOT (student.py:747 uses a 6-tuple pad)

findings.summary: With w=w_cell*w_pat and batch 1, w_pat is a per-sample constant that cancels exactly in sum(w*KL)/sum(w), so V1 and V1-u differ only on w_pat=0 patients.
findings.evidence: probe: identical loss 0.62272 at w scaled by 1.0 and by 0.05
findings.correction: needs coordinator decision: multiply the class-balanced w_cell mean by w_pat outside the normalization (loss_sample = w_pat * L_codeKD(w_cell)), or normalize across the accumulation window/batch; record it as a spec-formula limitation
findings.status: ACCEPTED_SPEC_LIMITATION (coordinator: exact formula locked with eps 1e-8; w_pat not moved). Consequence to report: with batch 1, V1 and V1-u differ only on w_pat=0 patients

findings.where: _class_balanced_weighted_mean raise when all classes are zero-weight
findings.summary: An intentional physiology guard w_pat=0 (or all w_cell<0.7) turns every weight to zero, and codekd raises ValueError, crashing that update.
findings.evidence: probe: weights*0 raise 'all class-balanced distillation weights are zero'
findings.correction: distinguish an intentional w_pat=0 (skip the U term, log guard reason and count) from a global collapse (fail if the skipped fraction in a declared window exceeds a threshold, or if all U patients have w_pat=0 at stage P)
findings.status: FIXED_VERIFIED (engine _distillation_or_zero skips an all-zero branch and logs it; global KD collapse raises if no branch has positive support over the stage, engine.py:2374)

findings.summary: Class coverage uses the hard argmax class per cell with count 1, not soft class mass, and comes only from the last metrics() call's batch; the gate cohort is therefore one volume.
findings.correction: accumulate mass[c,k] += sum of pooled teacher class probabilities over cells assigned code k, across the declared L+U gate cohort with frozen candidate weights; owner = argmax_c mass; record the cohort IDs
findings.status: FIXED_PENDING_ENGINE_INTEGRATION (tokenizer 9d9f3bb2: rolling soft class mass over the last history_window cohorts, majority >50% of code mass); recorded interpretation: the gate cohort is the last 200 Q-stage observations, which mix successive C0 snapshots; the engine must pass soft pooled class_probs

findings.summary: Frozen reload restores is_frozen=True, but every parameter keeps requires_grad=True.
findings.correction: in set_extra_state or a load_state_dict post-hook, call requires_grad_(False) and eval() when is_frozen; the engine must also assert that frozen modules are absent from the optimizer
findings.status: FIXED (tokenizer _load_from_state_dict re-freezes when is_frozen)

findings.summary: VQ arms silently get a random 'untrained-init' C0 when no codebook is passed. codebook_version is not persisted: after reload the version_id buffer is 0 and the attribute reverts to the untrained-init string.
findings.correction: for non-synthetic runs, require a codebook mapping carrying the frozen tokenizer C0 plus sha256, version and frozen=True; persist the version and sha in state (extra_state) and verify on load and export
findings.status: FIXED_VERIFIED (student install_codebook/codebook_metadata with sha/version/frozen; VQ forward fails before install; metadata in extra_state)

findings.summary: Canonical config arms v1u, e1, o1 and s1 raise 'unsupported Q-3D student arm'. Config model.student.epa_support='adaptive' is not read, so E1 silently runs uniform EPA. teacher feature_channels is absent from the config, so C1 construction raises.
findings.evidence: probe2 over canonical_config for all arms
findings.correction: one canonical arm and key mapping shared by config and student, plus a test that constructs a student from canonical_config for every arm
findings.status: FIXED_VERIFIED (engine translation layer; config carries teacher feature_channels; C1 requires it)

findings.summary: Config tokenizer keys (dimension, adapter_hidden, anatomy_loss_weight, usage_window_updates, minimum_perplexity, maximum_dead_code_fraction, minimum_class_codes, dead_code_fraction) do not match the keys the tokenizer reads, so the locked gate values come from code defaults.
findings.evidence: probe: minimum_perplexity 99 and window 7 in config give 32 and 200 in the tokenizer
findings.correction: map the config keys explicitly and fail on unknown or missing keys
findings.status: FIXED_VERIFIED (engine _tokenizer_config maps canonical keys; tokenizer validates options)

findings.summary: The config does not say whether 8000 updates are logical or optimizer updates.
findings.correction: add update_unit='logical' plus derived optimizer_updates (J=4000 at accumulation 2), and key ramp, warmup, cosine and the 400-update evaluation cadence on the logical counter
findings.status: FIXED_VERIFIED (J counters j_logical_updates/j_optimizer_updates/j_stream_microbatches; 8000 pairs = 8000 optimizer steps per user confirmation)

findings.summary: The adapter dispatches sequential blocks through model.iterative_checkpoint (teacher.py:309-313), so whether the dec_block_3 hook fires depends on official MedNeXt source not available locally. The code fails closed (raises if the capture count is not 1).
findings.evidence: official MedNeXt @0b78ed86: create_mednext_v1.py:49-62 sets n_channels=32 and checkpoint_style outside_block; MedNextV1.py:278-286 iterative_checkpoint calls each child via checkpoint.checkpoint, so a hook on dec_block_3 captures 0 times
findings.correction: when outside_block_checkpointing is True, hook dec_block_3[-1] (bottleneck[-1], dec_block_2[-1]); C_T=n_channels*8=256 (MedNextV1.py:175-178)
findings.status: FIXED_AND_RUNTIME_VERIFIED_BY_ROOT (dec_block_3.7, C_T 256, random init SOFTWARE_ONLY); hook code at teacher_features.py:45-55

findings.summary: Risk of double beta and anatomy weighting: forward already applies beta=0.25 and 0.5, and tokenizer_stage_loss applies them again.
findings.correction: the engine uses exactly one; add a test
findings.status: FIXED_VERIFIED (Q stage uses tokenizer_output['loss'] once; J commitment = beta * commitment / stream divisor)

findings.summary: Conflicts with spec line 269 and with augment_unlabeled, which always applies strong intensity to the U student view.
findings.correction: set 1.0, or have augment_unlabeled honor the declared probability
findings.status: FIXED_VERIFIED (config intensity_probability_unlabeled_student = 1.0)

findings.summary: torch.randint without a generator uses the global RNG, so exact resume requires saving and restoring the global RNG state.
findings.correction: use a seeded generator stored in extra_state
findings.status: FIXED (seeded restart generator persisted in extra_state)

findings.summary: The per-channel std is computed per batch (batch 1 means per volume), so the reconstruction normalizer varies by volume.
findings.correction: freeze the per-channel std from the k-means init cohort and persist it
findings.status: RECORDED_CHOICE (literal per-volume std of F_T_aln per coordinator)

findings.summary: When MYO is absent at both ED and ES, r_M=0 and w_m=1, so a teacher with no myocardium passes the physiology term.

findings.summary: Frames where one mask is absent get HD95=None and are silently excluded, so a candidate that misses a structure is not penalized in the 'HD95 not worse' gate.

findings.summary: 'harm rate giảm rõ' is implemented as any reduction > 0, which one patient can satisfy.
